It opens two indexed statistics files (DB2-STATS and BATCH-STATS, read sequentially) and the 132-byte REPORT-FILE, writes three header lines (asterisk rule, title 'SYSTEM STATISTICS AND PERFORMANCE REPORT', and the report date), and resets its DB2 and batch metric counters.
